title: Root disk full from unrotated debug logs
reason: The diagnosis matches the broken web component, identifies the disk‑full problem, and cites the new cron job as the trigger.
option_titles: Disable debug log cron job and move oversized log file
root_cause: The cron job 'collect-debug-logs' (added 2026-10-24) writes large debug dumps to /var/log/shop/debug.log every 10 minutes, growing it to 17.5 GB and filling the root filesystem to 97%. This causes the API container to fail with 'No space left on device' when writing log entries, returning 500 errors for dynamic requests.
truth: A new cron job 'collect-debug-logs' was added two days ago. It writes verbose debug output to /var/log/shop/debug.log but the logrotate config was not updated for this file, so the log grows unbounded. The root disk (/) reached 97% used, leaving no space for nginx to write its access log or for the api container to write its log, causing 500 errors on all dynamic requests.
check_first: inspect the api container's logs and health endpoint
